Saving from a single web-address box feels right and pleasantly quick. A title is important, but I’d want the app to fetch the page’s real title automatically and let me change it.

At a glance, I’d prefer the real title, a short description, tags, and the site icon. The address and saved time can be secondary. Most importantly, clicking the saved item should open the original page; otherwise I can’t actually revisit the bookmark.
